items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Oh of course not but he was great. In fact we did an album together.

ctx.x: Well sure and if you had been able to write it down and give it to him to play it, he couldn’t play it.
